title: Painted Figures, Places and Color Fields
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Dates and stroke counts come from data/gallery.json; the May 25, 2022 purchase and the August 14, 2022 gift from the Gnosis ledger (curation/research/onchain/); the artist's bio line from curation/research/social/. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 24 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: This room is painted. The marks are soft, broad and blended, and the line, when it appears, sits on top of color instead of making it. Twenty-four works from the first six months of the series, December 2021 to June 2022, hang here because they share that surface, and because they are the works where the artist let the drawing be beautiful without a joke in it.

What is painted changes from week to week. A dancer and a duck in a room, a sunset over water on Christmas Eve, a sky of pale cloud, a house in a field, a figure in a yellow raincoat, a woman wrapped in cloth, a rooster, an elephant, a mouse. Between them come color fields with no subject at all: drips, stripes, a plaid of black and red. The artist's handle on every platform began with four zeros, and the bio line read born readymade to please the eye. This is the room where that line is simply true.

In most of the series the ground is flat color. Here it is air, cloud, light and weather, and the figures stand in it, not on it. The astronaut, the most anxious face in the room, was the collector's fourth purchase from the series, bought on May 25, 2022, the day it was drawn. The barn full of figures that closes the room is the last work of the series' first part, made June 4, 2022, four days before the masks began.

chapters.title: Faces in the Light
chapters.opening: Four works from the first three weeks. Faces float in soft light, a dancer and a duck share a room, and the first color field and the first landscape arrive. The first of them was among the five works the artist sent the collector in August 2022.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #3
works.text: Faces float in pink and gold light, drawn as thin blue and yellow outlines over a ground of soft overlapping discs. Six of them hang at the left and the top like balloons, each with two round eyes and a mouth, and a profile with spiky hair stands in the middle looking right. The whole picture glows, and nothing in it is solid. It was made on December 8, 2021, the same day as the first two works in the series, and it is the first painted one. On the first day the artist drew a crowd of teeth, a winged figure, and this: faces as light, pleased and weightless. It was one of the five earliest works sent to the collector on August 14, 2022.
works.caption: Faces drawn in thin blue and yellow outline float in pink and gold light, a spiky-haired profile among them.
works.reading: The discs of the ground are drawn in soft pink, brown and cream, and they overlap until the light seems to come from behind them. The floating faces are drawn in loops of blue and yellow line with red and green inside. A yellow pointed shape at the right has a face drawn on it too.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #9
works.text: A dancer in a short gold dress raises her arms and shouts, and beside her a duck in a feathered coat stands with its wings folded, under a hooked lamp. Both are painted in gold and brown with scribble over them, and the room behind them is a weave of pink, lilac and gold lines. The dancer's face is red with a wide open mouth; the duck's eyes are narrow and its beak is shut. It is the most peopled painting in the room, with 562 recorded strokes. One of them is having the time of her life and the other has seen it all before, and the picture is funny because it will not say which of them is right.
works.caption: A dancer in a gold dress shouts with raised arms beside a duck in a feathered coat.
works.reading: The duck's coat is built from hundreds of short strokes in red, blue, yellow and white over brown, and its yellow beak is the brightest thing in the picture. The dancer's dress is a bell of gold with a white edge. The lamp is a hooked tube that comes down from the top right. The floor is a band of pink and lilac scribble.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #11
works.text: No figure at all: vertical drips of orange, red, blue, white and brown run down the square, crossed by a few white and red lines.
works.caption: Vertical drips of orange, red, blue, white and brown run down the square, crossed by a few white lines.
works.reading: The drips are broad strokes that start near the top and run to the bottom, overlapping until the ground is mostly orange. White lines are drawn over them in short vertical dashes and a few horizontal bars. It is the first work in the collection with no face or figure.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #15
works.text: A sunset over water. Pale cloud at the top, a band of orange and gold at the horizon, and below it a winding channel of blue water between dark purple and green banks, painted in soft overlapping strokes with scribble on top. It is the first landscape in the series, made on Christmas Eve 2021, and the most densely drawn work in the room. Nothing in it grins. For one evening in the first month, the block was a river and a sky, and the artist, who would spend the next year drawing teeth, drew the light going down over water and signed it.
works.caption: A sunset over winding blue water between dark purple and green banks, pale cloud above.
works.reading: The water is drawn as a channel that bends from the upper right down to the lower left, with the blue laid in soft discs and the edges scribbled in green and lilac. The horizon is a bright band of orange with yellow above it. The sky is pale grey cloud drawn in horizontal strokes.

chapters.title: Winter: Sky, House, Fields
chapters.opening: January and February 2022. A cloudy sky, a house in a field, and three color fields in a row, then a figure in a raincoat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #20
works.text: A sky of pale cloud, painted in cream, blue and pink discs with yellow light coming through the middle and thin blue and red lines drawn over the clouds.
works.caption: A sky of pale cloud in cream, blue and pink, yellow light through the middle, thin lines drawn over it.
works.reading: The clouds are lumpy shapes with blue scribbled edges, and the light in the center is a soft yellow glow with no edge at all. Thin vertical lines in blue, red and white run down through the clouds like rain. With 598 recorded strokes it is one of the most worked drawings in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #21
works.text: A house with a pitched roof drawn in brown and lime green line, standing in a field of olive and blue strokes under a sky of blue bars.
works.caption: A house drawn twice, in brown and in lime green line, in a field of olive strokes under blue bars.
works.reading: The house is drawn twice, once in brown and once in lime green, slightly out of register, so it seems to shimmer. The windows are small rectangles of green. The field is made of horizontal strokes in olive, yellow and blue, and the sky is a band of blue bars with white lines across it.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #34
works.text: On cream: a red block, a white block, a grey ring with a black center, a blue box hanging from a line, a magenta block, and three small green flowers on stems.
works.caption: On cream, a red block, a grey ring with a black center, a magenta block and three small flowers.
works.reading: The shapes are drawn in hatching, not filled, so the red block shows cream through it. The grey ring is a knot of circles with a black blot in the middle and a white line through it. Thin black lines run across the square at slight angles. The three flowers at the lower left have green centers and long stems.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #36
works.caption: Vertical strokes of blue, yellow, orange, red and teal on pale blue, crossed by five thin white lines.
works.reading: The strokes are soft-edged and translucent, and they overlap into pools of color at the left and the center. The white lines run straight across at even spacing. A dark purple bracket shape sits at the lower right. It was made on the same day as the cream picture with the grey ring.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #37
works.caption: A plaid of black, red, orange and yellow strokes on white, crossed by a few green and grey lines.
works.reading: The strokes run both ways, vertical and horizontal, and the colors pile up into a grid. The black lines are thickest and the orange ones brightest. Where the strokes cross, the white ground disappears. The whole square is pattern.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #38
works.text: A figure in a yellow raincoat with the hood up stands against dark green, its face in shadow under the hood except for a red mouth of pointed teeth and two red marks for eyes. The coat is painted in broad yellow strokes with white lines for the seams. One sleeve ends in a hand drawn in white and red. The figure fills the right half of the square and faces left into the dark. The coat is cheerful and the face inside it is not. It is the first time in the series that something bright is worn over something with teeth, and the masks of the summer will do it a hundred more times.
works.caption: A figure in a yellow raincoat, hood up, face in shadow except for a red mouth of pointed teeth.
works.reading: The hood is drawn as a soft dome with a dark oval for the face, and the teeth inside the oval are a double row of white triangles with red between them. The coat has a dark fold down the front and white lines for the stitching. The green ground is flat.

chapters.title: Spring Creatures
chapters.opening: March and April. A creature in a field of light, trees in a haze, a gown, a wrapped woman, a rooster and an elephant.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #40
works.text: A black creature with a striped head and a white grin crouches in a field of gold and purple discs, its spotted tail curling up behind it and a hand reaching out.
works.caption: A black creature with a striped head and a white grin crouches in gold light, its spotted tail curled.
works.reading: The tail is a thick striped tube that curls up and over, with pale blue spots along it and the discs of light showing through. The creature's head is small and striped in pink and white, with a green ball on a stalk between the eyes. Its 862 recorded strokes are the most in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #44
works.text: Trees in a haze of pale discs, drawn in thin blue, green and white line, a tall trunk at the center and grass at the bottom in loops.
works.caption: Trees drawn in thin blue, green and white line in a haze of pale discs, one tall trunk at center.
works.reading: The discs are pale yellow, pink and white, and they cover the whole square so the trees seem lit from everywhere. The trunk rises from the lower center to a crown of green strokes at the top. Red and blue lines fall through the right half like rain, and the grass is scribbled in green and blue.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #48
works.text: A figure in a huge brown gown turns away on olive, its arms a flurry of orange and black strokes, a spray of colored dots rising from it like confetti.
works.caption: A figure in a huge brown gown turns away on olive, colored dots rising from it like confetti.
works.reading: The gown is painted in soft brown and gold with a red edge, and it fills the lower half of the square. The arms and hair are drawn in loose strokes of orange, black and red at the top right, with a red collar between them. The dots are tiny points of pink, blue and yellow scattered over the olive.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #50
works.text: A woman with black hair in a bun and a small pale face stands wrapped in cloth: blue and pink bands wound across her chest, and a long striped robe of gold, brown and purple falling to the bottom edge. The ground is dark olive and flat. Her mouth is a small red mark and her eyes are two short lines. It is the stillest work in the room, and the only one that looks like a dressed person seen from the front. Her eyes are closed, or nearly. In a series where every face is turned to the viewer and most of them are shouting, she is the one who is not available, and the drawing respects that.
works.caption: A woman with black hair in a bun stands wrapped in blue and pink cloth over a long striped robe.
works.reading: The wrapping is drawn as overlapping bands with lines along their folds, blue on the outside and pink beneath. The robe is striped in vertical bands of gold, brown and purple with small loops of pattern inside the brown. The face is pale and flat with the features drawn in a few strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #56
works.text: A rooster painted in red, purple and blue feathers stands on blue, its yellow beak open, a white belly and a raised crest of spikes.
works.caption: A rooster in red, purple and blue feathers stands on blue, yellow beak open, a white belly, a spiky crest.
works.reading: The feathers are drawn in short strokes of red, purple, blue and white that follow the body, and the tail rises in a fan of the same strokes. The belly is a plain white oval. The eye is a white ring with a black pupil under a red brow, and the feet are two grey claws on dark shadows.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #59
works.text: An elephant with a curled trunk and small round eyes sits on yellow, its hide painted in grey and purple with scribble over it, flames rising from its head and tail.
works.caption: An elephant with a curled trunk sits on yellow, grey and purple hide, flames rising from its head and tail.
works.reading: The trunk curls down and around to the lower left in a spiral of ridged grey. The eyes are two pale rings close together above it. The flames are drawn in yellow and orange strokes at the top of the head and at the tip of the tail. Black shapes like a crowd of hands rise along the bottom edge.

chapters.title: May and June
chapters.opening: The last nine works, May 4 to June 4. An angel in the clouds, an astronaut the collector bought the day it was drawn, a mouse, a figure in a hat, a gold armored body, and a barn full of figures.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #65
works.text: A creature with a halo kneels in a bank of clouds under a gold sun, its head bowed and its hands raised, painted in brown and gold with white light on the edges, five days before the crash.
works.caption: A creature with a halo kneels in a bank of clouds under a gold sun, head bowed, hands raised.
works.reading: The clouds are drawn as white discs with blue and lilac between them, and the sun is a soft gold glow at the upper left. The creature's face has two small eyes and a mouth of pointed teeth, drawn in gold line over brown. The halo is a thin white ring above the head.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #104
works.text: An astronaut's head inside a round helmet, against black space full of white stars. The face is painted in soft gold and grey discs, with two mismatched eyes, a long nose and a grimace of teeth drawn in orange line. The helmet is a white ring with grey reflections. The face is the most anxious in the room: one eye wide, the other narrowed, the mouth pulled down at the corners. It was drawn on May 25, 2022, and Jamie Thingelstad bought it within hours for fifteen xDai, his fourth from the series. Two weeks after the market fell, a face sealed inside a helmet, far from everything, worried: it is easy to see why a collector who had just arrived on the board chose it.
works.caption: An astronaut's head in a round helmet against starry black, a grimace of teeth drawn in orange.
works.reading: The helmet is drawn as a thick white ring with grey and black shading on the right side, and the face inside it is made of soft gold discs with white highlights. The eyes are two rings with green and black centers, set at different heights. The stars are tiny white dots on a flat black ground.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #111
works.text: A mouse with round ears, black button eyes and whiskers hugs its own pink arms on a yellow ground inside a black frame, painted in gold, orange and pink.
works.caption: A mouse with round ears, black button eyes and whiskers hugs its own pink arms on yellow.
works.reading: The fur is painted in soft gold and orange with pink and blue highlights, and the arms are two pink tubes crossed over the belly. The eyes are black circles with white rings, and the nose is a black dot with a small white mouth below it. The yellow ground is flat and the frame is a thin black line.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #115
works.text: A figure in a wide-brimmed hat with flowers on it, seen from the side, its face a blur of pale grey and pink discs against white and blue haze, drawn almost entirely in translucent strokes.
works.caption: A figure in a wide-brimmed flowered hat, seen from the side, its face a blur of pale discs.
works.reading: The hat is a broad oval of grey with a soft rim, and the flowers on it are a small cluster of green and pink. The face below is almost dissolved: discs of grey, pink and cream with a few lines for the nose and mouth. The neck is a column of brown strokes. With 810 recorded strokes it is one of the two most worked drawings in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #127
works.caption: Orange with black blocks, blue and white diagonal stripes, green bars and scattered dots, in a tan frame.
works.reading: The black shapes are drawn as fat strokes with scribble inside, and the stripes cross them at a slant. Dots of blue, white and purple are scattered over everything. A small target of red, white and blue sits at the upper right.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #131
works.text: A gold armored body with two round yellow eyes and a grin of white teeth stands in a frame, its plates drawn in short strokes of gold, blue and white over black.
works.caption: A gold armored body with round yellow eyes and a white grin stands in a frame, built from blocks.
works.reading: The armor is built from blocks: a helmet, two shoulder plates, a chest of three panels, a belt of segments and heavy legs. Each block is filled with short strokes of gold and blue with white edges. The yellow ground behind is scribbled with soft yellow loops.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #137
works.text: A figure with a mass of dark red hair over its face holds a hand to its head, in a yellow shirt on a ground of yellow bars, the face hidden entirely.
works.caption: A figure with dark red hair over its whole face holds a hand to its head, on yellow bars.
works.reading: The hair is painted in brown and red scribble that covers the whole head and falls to the shoulders. The hand is drawn in grey with the fingers spread against the hair. The shirt is yellow with a blue band at the bottom. Four days after the figure in the hat, here is another face that cannot be seen, hidden this time by hair.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #139
works.text: Figures hang and climb in the rafters of a barn, painted in brown and gold over a ground of tall vertical strokes. One with a long face hangs from a beam at the right, two more sit on a shelf at the upper right, and a grinning head looks out from the lower corner. The whole picture is made of uprights, beams, legs and falling strokes. It is the last work of New Nifty on the Block's first part, made June 4, 2022. The crowd of the first week has come indoors and climbed into the dark, and the one face that looks out is grinning. Four days later the series began drawing masks and did almost nothing else for ten weeks.
works.caption: Figures hang and climb in the rafters of a barn, painted in brown and gold over tall vertical strokes.
works.reading: The ground is drawn as columns of tan, gold and brown with soft edges, like boards. The figures are drawn in dark brown strokes with gold on their edges, and their faces are small and pale with dark eyes. The beam at the right is a dark bar with a figure's arms hooked over it.

closing: The first painting has faces floating in pink light, and nothing in it has an edge. The last has figures hanging in a barn made of boards. The soft ground is still there in both. What changed is that the figures found something to hold on to, and that the thing they hold on to is a beam, in a barn, in the dark. The gentlest room in the wing ends on the edge of the summer of masks.

collectorDecisions.decision: Collector, 2026-10-16: depth pass. Market, platform, people and the collector may be named; the artist's sourced words may be read for feeling.
